name: XLA_FSN_BAL_BSV_GT
description: This table is used by the Accounting Engine when running Entered Currency or Rounding balancing on big transactions or on transactions that need Intercompany balancing.  It is used to store the combinations that need to be balanced, and the amount that they are off by.  It also stores the type of balancing necessary and the account combination to be used.

columns.name: AE_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Accounting entry identifier to be balanced.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Three-letter ISO code associated with a currency.

columns.name: UNRND_ENTERED_DELTA
columns.description: Unrounded entered amount to be plugged.

columns.name: UNRND_ACCOUNTED_DELTA
columns.description: Unrounded accounted amount to be plugged

columns.name: ENTERED_DELTA
columns.description: Rounded entered amount to be plugged.

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_DELTA
columns.description: Rounded accounted amount to be plugged.

columns.name: BAL_SIGN_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the amount to be plugged is a debit or a credit (D or C).

columns.name: BAL_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether entered currency balancing or rounding balancing is necessary (E or I).

columns.name: ACCT_STATUS
columns.description: Result of validating the account combination to be used when balancing.

columns.name: CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Account combination to be used when balancing.

columns.name: ENCUMBRANCE_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Encumbrance type (if encumbrances) to be balanced.
